To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we can derive surface aerosol concentration from size-resolved MISRAODs, 2) we can use low-cost OPCs to calibrate the size-resolved AODs, 3) the combined data can provide surface-PM concentrations, and 4) we can use the combined data to derive PM concentrations for particles as fine as ~ 0:1 μm, that are not detected by the OPCs.
we have demonstrated the potential of combining size-resolved satellite data with low-cost, surface based monitors to derive surface PM concentrations.
